svg.title: Experience
svg.desc: Experience. 1. ARCHITECTURE: Cloud-native designs on AWS, Azure and GCP. DDD, event-driven, observable from day one, load- and chaos-tested before shipping. Ten years across fintech, banking, logistics and transportation. 2. INTEGRATION: Expertise in enterprise integration: Enterprise Integration Patterns with Apache Camel on Quarkus, and event streaming with Kafka Connect, Debezium and Kafka Streams. 3. AI-NATIVE DEVELOPER: AI is in every step: spec, design, code, review, release. I build agent harnesses, MCP servers, skills, agents, and the governance that lets a company trust them. Claude Code, the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, LangChain, MCP and Hugging Face. 4. TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP: More than 200 people led over the last five years. I coach developers into senior and architect roles and run corporate AI trainings, so a whole team can work this way.
